# Negentro Documentation

> Negentro is the persistent memory and context layer for AI agents. Store, search, and recall context across sessions via SDK, REST API, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Getting Started
- [Build AI Applications With Negentro Memory and Context](https://docs.negentro.tech/index.md): Negentro is the persistent memory and context layer for AI agents. Store, search and recall context across sessions via SDK, REST API or MCP.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.negentro.tech/quickstart.md): Start using Negentro in less than 5 minutes.

## Open Source & Self-Hosted Infrastructure
- [Self Hosted Overview](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/overview.md): Run Negentro on your own infrastructure with full control over your data, configuration, and deployment environment.
- [Python SDK Quickstart](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/python-sdk.md): Install and integrate Negentro embedded memory into your Python agents, LLM pipelines, and backend services.
- [Node.js Quickstart](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/nodejs-quickstart.md): Integrate stateful memory and context management into TypeScript and Node.js applications with native ESM and CommonJS support.
- [Web Studio](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/web-studio.md): A visual administrative interface and debugger for inspecting memories, tuning retrieval parameters, and managing users.
- [Self-hosted REST API](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/rest-api.md): Complete HTTP interface for interacting with the Negentro memory engine from any programming language or framework.
- [Configuration](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/configuration.md): Fine-tune every layer of the memory stack — from vector dimensions and chunking strategies to LLM inference pipelines.
- [LLMs & Model Routing](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/llms.md): Configure inference engines for fact extraction, summarization, entity resolution, and context generation.
- [Vector Databases](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/vector-databases.md): Select and configure the high-dimensional vector substrate powering semantic memory recall.
- [Embeddings](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/embeddings.md): Configure dense vector representations for text, code, and multimodal entities across local and cloud models.
- [Storage & Knowledge Graphs](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/storage.md): Durable transactional storage for relational memories, bitemporal graphs, session logs, and cache layers.
- [UnifiedScorer & Reranking](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/reranking.md): Combine dense semantic similarity, sparse BM25 text match, recency decay, and cross-encoders for precision retrieval.
- [Multimodal Memory Support](https://docs.negentro.tech/open-source/multimodal.md): Store, index, and retrieve memories across images, documents, audio transcripts, and structured tables.

## Framework & Tool Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/overview.md): Connect Negentro with the frameworks, agent platforms, developer tools, and infrastructure you already use.
- [LangChain Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/langchain.md): Official LangChain adapter ( packages/langchain-adapter ) providing persistent bitemporal memory retrieval and context injection for LangChain chains and agents.
- [LangGraph Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/langgraph.md): State management and persistent memory retrieval for LangGraph cyclical graphs.
- [LlamaIndex Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/llamaindex.md): Connect Negentro bitemporal memory and vector stores to LlamaIndex query engines.
- [CrewAI Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/crewai.md): Persistent shared memory and state recall for CrewAI multi-agent crews.
- [AutoGen Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/autogen.md): Connect Negentro persistent memory to Microsoft AutoGen multi-agent conversations.
- [Mastra Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/mastra.md): Persistent memory and workflow state integration for Mastra TypeScript agents.
- [UX Pilot AI Agents SDK](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/uxpilot.md): UX Pilot AI Agents SDK integration with persistent user preference memory.
- [Google ADK](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/google-adk.md): Memory and bitemporal context integration for Google Agent Development Kit (ADK).
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/vercel-ai.md): Integrate Negentro memory provider into Next.js and Vercel AI SDK applications.
- [LiveKit Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/livekit.md): Real-time voice and multimodal agent memory integration with LiveKit WebRTC sessions.
- [Pipecat](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/pipecat.md): Voice agent memory integration with Pipecat WebRTC and real-time audio pipelines.
- [ElevenLabs](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/elevenlabs.md): Real-time voice context and conversational memory for ElevenLabs conversational agents.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/mcp.md): Official @piyapi/mcp-server providing standard stdio transport for IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, VS Code) with 30 Tools, 3 Resources, and 3 Pr....
- [REST API Integration](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/rest-api.md): Direct programmatic access to memories, vector search, cognitive RAG, and context assembly at https://api.piyapi.cloud.
- [Client SDKs (TypeScript & Python)](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/sdks.md): Official client libraries for TypeScript/Node.js ( @piyapi/sdk ) and Python ( piyapi-memory ).
- [Webhooks & Real-Time Event System](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/webhooks.md): HTTP callbacks for memory lifecycle mutations ( memory.created ), CDC data sync completions ( sync.completed ), and BYOK key alerts ( byok.key_failed ) with ....
- [PostgreSQL & pgvector](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/postgresql.md): Enterprise-grade bitemporal storage substrate and dense vector indexes backing Negentro / PiAPI.
- [Redis Semantic Caching](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/redis.md): Ultra-low latency semantic caching layer and token budget acceleration.
- [Vector Databases & Hybrid Search](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/vectordbs.md): Multi-signal hybrid retrieval engine combining dense vector search and BM25 trigram full-text search.
- [Cloud Providers](https://docs.negentro.tech/integrations/cloud-providers.md): Deployment guides for running Negentro memory clusters on AWS, GCP, and Azure.

- [Research Assistant for YouTube](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/research-yt.md): Ingest YouTube video transcripts, timestamps, and chapters into hybrid search.
- [Smart Travel Assistant](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/travel-assistant.md): Remember traveler preferences, loyalty accounts, and trip planning context.
- [Multi-Session Research Agent](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/multi-session.md): Execute asynchronous, long-horizon research workflows without context degradation using the Session Mining Engine.
- [Memory-Powered Customer Support Agent](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/support-agent.md): Ingest customer ticket streams and empower support agents with continuous historical context.
- [Automated Email Intelligence](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/email-intelligence.md): Parse, vectorize, and extract persistent knowledge from high-volume corporate email threads.
- [Content Creation Workflow](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/content-creation.md): Store brand guidelines, voice definitions, and editorial constraints.
- [Collaborative Task Assistant](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/collaborative-task.md): Multi-user task synchronization and collaborative thread memory.
- [Memory-Powered Agent SDK (TypeScript, Python, LangChain)](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/agent-sdk.md): Standardized SDK integrations for autonomous agent frameworks.
- [Memory as an API Tool (Function Calling)](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/api-tool.md): Expose atomic memory storage and recall tools to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini function calling.
- [Healthcare Context & PHI/PII Redaction](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/healthcare-adk.md): HIPAA-compliant patient memory storage with cryptographic tokenization and zero-knowledge redaction.
- [Personal Context Search & RAG Summaries](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/personal-search.md): High-throughput hybrid search fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF_K=30) and token-budget context assembly.
- [Persistent Mastra Agents](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/mastra-agents.md): Connecting Negentro memory to the Mastra TypeScript agent framework.
- [AWS Bedrock with Persistent Memory](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/bedrock-memory.md): Combining AWS Bedrock foundation models with Negentro cognitive memory stores.
- [AI Agents with Unified 8-Operator Memory Surface](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/ai-agents.md): Standardized lifecycle operators: store, retrieve, update, delete, merge, summarize, pin, verify.
- [Multi-Agent Collaboration with Speculative Branching](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/multi-agent.md): Isolate agent reasoning trials into ephemeral branches and merge verified discoveries with 3-way conflict resolution.
- [Persistent Persona & Pinned Memory Weighting](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/persistent-persona.md): Maintain deterministic agent tone, core principles, and identity using memory pinning and assistant boost.
- [Visual Memory Retrieval](https://docs.negentro.tech/cookbooks/visual-memory.md): Multimodal image embedding and combined visual-text context recall.

## REST API Reference
- [API Reference Overview](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/overview.md): Explore the PiyAPI REST API for memory management, search, entity operations, and persistent context with endpoints, auth, and quick start steps.
- [Add Memories](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/add-memories.md): Store new information, agent interactions, and bitemporal facts into persistent memory.
- [Get Memories](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/get-memories.md): List stored memories scoped to your user or project with tag and date range filtering.
- [Search Memories](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/search-memories.md): Execute multi-signal hybrid search fusing pgvector HNSW dense vectors and BM25 trigram full-text scores.
- [Update Memory](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/update-memory.md): Modify content, tags, or bitemporal validity of an existing memory record, generating a new revision version.
- [Delete Memory](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/delete-memory.md): Soft-delete a memory record or remove it from the active context assembly graph.
- [Adaptive Feedback API](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/feedback.md): Train the UnifiedScorer ranking engine with positive and negative retrieval feedback.
- [Get Memory by ID](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/get-memory.md): Retrieve a single memory object by its unique UUID identifier.
- [Memory Version History](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/memory-history.md): Inspect complete revision logs, timestamp diffs, and bitemporal valid_at history for a given memory.
- [Bulk Update Memories](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/submit-update.md): Bulk append or replace tags and metadata across multiple memory records in a single transactional operation.
- [Batch Delete Memories](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/batch-delete.md): Bulk delete memories matching specific tag criteria, category filters, or time boundaries.
- [Delete Memories](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/delete-memories.md): Targeted multi-record soft deletion and namespace purge operations.
- [Create Memory Export](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/create-export.md): Create an atomic export of memory datasets for compliance and data portability.
- [Get Memory Export](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/get-export.md): Retrieve the download status and URL for an active memory export job.
- [Organizations API](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/organizations.md): Manage multi-tenant organizations, API keys, and access controls.
- [Projects API](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/projects.md): Manage projects, scopes, and isolation boundaries within an organization.
- [Get Events](https://docs.negentro.tech/api-reference/get-events.md): Query audit logs and lifecycle events for memory mutations.
